description: Feral rock pigeon 'Pedro' cooing, Paris, hand-held Olympus LS-12 under 50 cm (xeno-canto XC539061 via Wikimedia Commons)

extractions.what: Tracked note by note (method and tables in input coo-pitch-analysis, section 3.1): 18 of 26 segments used. The fundamental is an arch, 193 Hz at the start of a note, 256 Hz at its top, 200 Hz at its end. The loudest partial is the second harmonic (92 % of the energy, 10.6 dB over the fundamental): 380 Hz at the start (quartiles 363 to 413), 511 Hz at its highest (455 to 533), 382 Hz at the end; energy-weighted 449 Hz. A note lasts 0.38 s and notes start 0.94 s apart.
extractions.note: One hand-fed feral pigeon in Paris, sex not known, hand-held recorder under 50 cm. This is the one recording in which the loudest partial sweeps low, high, low; its low end is 380 Hz, not the 340 Hz the person chose.
